answer: Like a cedar rooted in karst, honest stake grows slowly and cannot be faked; a sybil swarm burns its ember of capital fast, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn stake: each agent locks a bond that is slashed to zero if colluding identities are detected, so forging N fake participants costs N times the bond. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
